description: This file defines a template class TpmSerializable for serializing and deserializing TPM types, specifically TPM2B_PRIVATE and TPM2B_PUBLIC, as part of the keymaster serialization framework. It includes necessary TPM and logging headers and is part of the cuttlefish namespace.

classes.name: TpmSerializable
classes.description: A template class implementing keymaster::Serializable for TPM types, managing serialization and deserialization via an unmanaged pointer.

methods.name: TpmSerializable
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the TpmSerializable with a pointer to a TPM type.

methods.name: SerializedSize
methods.description: Returns the size of the serialized data.

methods.name: Serialize
methods.description: Serializes the TPM type data into a buffer.

methods.name: Deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes data from a buffer into the TPM type.
